name: utmp_parse
description: Parse the binary login databases — wtmp, btmp, utmp and lastlog — into records: type, user, terminal, source host and address, PID and time. The counterweight to text logs, and the file an attacker who cleans auth.log usually forgets.

path.description: A wtmp, btmp or utmp file

types.description: Keep only these record types, e.g. ["USER_PROCESS","BOOT_TIME"]

user.description: Case-insensitive regex over the user name
